# XLLocker by ReflectMyIdea

Excel Add-in for secured data sharing
An Excel COM add-in providing domain-locked security, proprietary formula protection, and centralized real-time access control via Windows Active Directory. Removes password sharing entirely by utilizing corporate network credentials.

## keywords
file locker, excel protection, data protection, sensitive data protection, confidential records protection, finance modeling, business secrets protection, historical data protection, data encryption, data loss prevention, IPR protection, intellectual property protection, Hardware Lock, Domain Lock, AD Group Lock, MFA (TOTP), time-based one-time password, Microsoft Authenticator, Google Authenticator, Life Sciences Reports, CROs Financial Banking, retainer agreements records, employment contracts records, secured data sharing, formula protection, time to market, reflectcode, reflect code, Artificial Intelligence

## Features
Native Excel ribbon add-in integration
Centralised control via Active Directory groups
System hardware-based locking capabilities
Network-based Domain Locking
Multi-Factor Authentication (TOTP via Microsoft Authenticator)
Custom authorization server callback logic
Real-time access and authorization audit logging
Automated 20-minute recurring permission revalidation

## Type of locks
Hardware Lock : Files can be opened on specific authorized system only.
Domain Lock : Only users logged in with corporate network domain credentials can open the file.
AD Group Lock : Only users who are members of a specific AD group (HR, Accounts, etc.) can open the file.
MFA (TOTP) : TOTP (time-based one-time password) via the Microsoft Authenticator app, for an extra verification step.
Custom Lock : Any authorisation process e.g. calling your own corporate authorization server to fetch and enforce access permissions.
Real time activity log : Events such as File open/close, Authorization status, Unauthorized access to central server in real time.
Centralized control : Your Administration team stays fully in control.  e.g. if employee in HR department resigns, Admin simply removes him from the HR AD group, their access to the locked Excel file is revoked immediately. 
Periodic recheck : The add-in also revalidates authorization every 20 minutes, so even a file that's already open will re-lock shortly after IT removes access.
